why: Removes a viewport that is not one of criterion 5's two, proving the count guard is doing work the two per-viewport assertions cannot. Dropping an entry makes the sweep cheaper and every required check faster and greener, and the only visible trace is the viewport number in `verify.mjs`'s own summary line, which nothing reads back.
